svg.text: Concept 7 · one frontend/caddy/Caddyfile · one address for the dashboard, the API, Socket.IO, and Grafana
the site address in the Caddyfile:
This address is for the MQTT broker (port 8883),
/grafana redirected to /grafana/; the cookie gets Secure
files in /srv (the dist/ contents), screens → index.html
WEB_DOMAIN empty in .env → compose.cloud.yml fills in :80 (Caddy only uses its fallback when the variable DOESN'T EXIST)
Caddy asks for the certificate, HTTPS 443,
HTTPS is set up by Cloudflare;
trustProxy: the backend trusts Caddy's information about visitors
simulated lab, three visitors from the "internet"
the backend sees the visitors as
all = Caddy's IP in the hallway (lab: 172.19.0.4), http
each visitor's real IP (A, B, C each), https
Secure: the browser only sends it over HTTPS
only visitor A 429; visitor B in (200)
429 too (the limit shared by all visitors)
Caddy overwrites it; counted on C's real IP
Backend log at startup: trusted proxies (TRUST_PROXY): uniquelocal · a hop number (TRUST_PROXY=1) is refused · CORS_ORIGIN=https://iot.yourname.my.id exactly (else 403)
